name: comikumi
description: Local-first manga localization workspace — plan, translate, letter, review and publish manga in multiple languages.
author: Hanjo Winter

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix server run test && npm --prefix client run test
scripts.electron:dev: npm run electron:build:main && concurrently -k -n server,client,electron -c blue,green,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev" "electron electron/dist/main.js"
scripts.electron:build: npm run build && npm run electron:build:main && electron-builder
scripts.electron:build:win: npm run build && npm run electron:build:main && electron-builder --win
scripts.electron:build:mac: npm run build && npm run electron:build:main && electron-builder --mac
scripts.electron:build:linux: npm run build && npm run electron:build:main && electron-builder --linux
